events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in 1969.

angles.name: Summer of Love Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Woodstock Festival, a three-day celebration that defined a generation. What's your favourite iconic moment or performance from '69?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 91
events.blurb: Remembering Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, who passed away on this day in 1977. He would have been 91.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91. His music and legacy continue to inspire.

events.title: Tupac Shakur would have been 55
events.blurb: Remembering hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled talent of Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55. His words and music still resonate profoundly.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix would have been 84
events.blurb: Remembering legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar Hero Tribute
angles.copy: A true pioneer, Jimi Hendrix left us on this day in 1970. We celebrate the genius of a man who would have been 84 and forever changed the sound of the guitar.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That zebra crossing! Today marks the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album. What's your favourite track from this timeless masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce attitude have made The Pretenders a rock institution.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock N Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that undeniable rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam track, solo or Oasis?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on October 11, 1971, and the album on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: A Song for Peace
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' by John Lennon continues to be a powerful anthem for peace and unity. What does it mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: The Music Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Today marks the anniversary of the original iPod's launch – the device that changed how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: A Timeless Voice
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', he's given us countless laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped on this day in '68. Its experimental sound and diverse tracks proved the Fab Four were still pushing boundaries.

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Queen's Legendary Frontman
angles.copy: On this day, we honour the extraordinary Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
